cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(cheryl_standalone_sdk_consumer LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(Cheryl 4 CONFIG REQUIRED)
enable_testing()
add_executable(sdk-standalone main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(sdk-standalone PRIVATE Cheryl::Cheryl)
add_test(NAME sdk-standalone COMMAND sdk-standalone)
if(TARGET Cheryl::UI::TGUI)
    add_executable(sdk-tgui-native native-tgui.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sdk-tgui-native PRIVATE Cheryl::UI::TGUI)
    add_test(NAME sdk-tgui-native COMMAND sdk-tgui-native)
endif()
